# Madhu Manish Digi Tech Studio

> Madhu Manish Digi Tech Studio is a premier professional photography studio and keepsake atelier based in Thoothukudi (Tuticorin), Tamil Nadu, India. Specializing in traditional and candid wedding photography, sacred South Indian ceremonies, luxury photo albums, varmala resin preservation, and personalized gifts.

## Overview

- **Business Name:** Madhu Manish Digi Tech Studio
- **Founder & Lead Photographer:** S ArumugaKumar
- **Established:** 2015
- **Headquarters / Studio:** 76-A, New Colony Road, Pudugramam, Thoothukudi (Tuticorin), Tamil Nadu 628003, India
- **Primary Website:** https://madhumanish.studio/
- **Google Maps Location:** https://g.co/kgs/1kw5BNY
- **Contact Phone:** +91 94435-62449 / +91 94431-23456
- **Contact Email:** info@madhumanish.studio
- **Operating Hours:** Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM | Saturday: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM | Sunday: Closed (Open by appointment for events & shoots)

## Service Coverage Areas

Madhu Manish Digi Tech Studio provides on-location event and wedding photography across Southern Tamil Nadu, including:
- Tuticorin / Thoothukudi
- Tiruchendur
- Tirunelveli
- Tenkasi
- Kovilpatti
- Madurai
- Kanyakumari & Nagercoil

## Core Photography & Videography Services

- **Candid & Traditional Wedding Photography:** Comprehensive pre-wedding, muhurtham, reception coverage, cinematic wedding films, drone videography, and bridal portraits.
- **Traditional Ceremonies & Milestones:**
  - Puberty Ceremony / Manjal Neerattu Vizha / Sadangu
  - Valaikappu / Seemantham / Baby Shower
  - Grahapravesam / House Warming Ceremonies
  - Ayush Homam, Sashtiabdhapoorthi (60th Birthday), and Sathabishekam (80th Birthday)
- **Portrait & Family Photography:** Studio and outdoor portraiture, kids & baby milestone shoots, maternal portraits, and multi-generational family sessions.
- **Event & Corporate Coverage:** Conferences, corporate headshots, inaugurations, school/college events, and live celebrations with multi-camera setups.
- **Commercial & Product Photography:** Catalog and e-commerce product shots, industrial shoots, architectural and interior photography.

## Keepsakes, Printing & Gifting Studio

- **Luxury Flush-Mount Photo Albums:** Custom-designed, lay-flat albums with metallic, velvet, leatherette, or acrylic covers and waterproof, non-tearable HD pages.
- **Wedding Garland (Varmala) Resin Preservation:** Preserving sacred wedding garlands, bridal bouquets, and florals into customized resin clocks, tables, and display blocks.
- **Personalized Printing & Gifting:** Custom photo magic mugs, photo mugs, customized t-shirts, acrylic wall photo prints, and canvas wraps.
- **Custom Photo Frames:** Handcrafted photo framing ranging from 4x6 inch table frames up to 16x20+ inch wall portraits in wooden, synthetic, and glass finishes.
- **Document & ID Photos:** High-resolution biometric passport-size and stamp-size photographs tailored for visas, exams, and government applications with quick turnaround.
